listings.thesis: levered to AI-driven fab and HBM capacity additions; upside depends on order timing and export-control risk.

priorCase.rankRationale: AI-node lens: FY3/27 guidance reaffirming HBM/DDR/foundry capex keeps SCREEN a direct memory-capex beneficiary, a modest fundamental positive vs Jun 9. But the new US export-control legislative push (MATCH Act) is an emerging China-WFE risk; +102% YTD already prices the upside, so hold.

SCREEN Holdings should hold because AI-driven 300mm, memory and advanced-node wafer-equipment spend remains relevant, but current rank 17, 47.0% YTD, $15.6B market cap, valuation discovery or execution risk already captures much of the upside.
